column1: # Hand-found lemma defects of LexiqueMixte.tsv rows (TODO.md item 3), replayed by `lexique.py` `outputMixedLexique` after the tag
# corrections (src/mixtecorrections.py `applyLemmaCorrections`). Key: the output row as Lexique383 has it (ortho, cgram, the WRONG lemme,
# genre, nombre, infover as written, trailing ';' included); only the lemme is replaced (new_lemme), so the sounds and the syllabification
# stay as they are. A key that matches no row, or several, fails the build.
# Not here: `rapiécer` (right lemma, no Verbiste template: see resources/verbModelExceptions.tsv), `retraire` (right lemma and template:
# traire is defective, no passé simple), `écher` (right lemma, see verbModelExceptions.tsv).

column8: Lexique383 files this accentless spelling under the non-word liserer; lisérait / liséré / lisérés have lemma lisérer
same: feminine participle of lisérer (the Mixte file has no lisérée)
